application_version.schema_rule: derived: the number of files in infrastructure/migrations (impact_api/version.py)

authority: Original backlog and task cores preserved. Additive execution/verification recommendations use the attached bundle; no owner/engineer approval, checker PASS, Ready/Done, sprint selection or run claimed.
native_update_policy: Append reconciliation only after live issue readback; root/native writer owns publication. Preserve human edits, status, estimates, assignees, parents, milestones and every existing dependency. This file is not a bulk status update.

bundle_source.identity_note: Shipped identity from bundle entry, not a new trust-store approval or checker pass.

source_preservation: The 37 original blocks are retained byte-for-byte in the matrix; these separate notes do not insert Given into the source or increase the original scenario count.
